A low-angle shot of a green lawn shows a silver flip phone with a coiled black cord and orange earbuds lying on the grass. A person wearing grey trousers and brown shoes walks into frame from the left, bends down, and picks up the phone. The camera tilts up to reveal an elderly man with a long white beard and hair, wearing a brown shirt and dark vest, holding the phone and earbuds. He looks at the device, then turns and walks away from the camera across the lawn toward a background of dense green bushes, a wooden bench, and a large pink flowering shrub.
